description: Rescore ADNP2 and ADNP using the empirically derived contact positions from 35 DNA-bound homeodomain chains, and superpose the AlphaFold ADNP2 homeodomain onto the Antennapedia-DNA complex 9ANT
code:
# =====================================================================
# Part 1: rescore ADNP2 / ADNP using contact positions measured from
#         DNA-bound structures instead of positions taken from reviews.
# Part 2: rigid-body superposition of the AlphaFold ADNP2 homeodomain
#         onto Antennapedia in 9ANT, then measure where ADNP2 residues
#         sit relative to the DNA in that frame.
# =====================================================================
import requests, numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
AA3 = {"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G","HIS":"H",
       "ILE":"I","LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S","THR":"T","TRP":"W",
       "TYR":"Y","VAL":"V","MSE":"M"}
DNA = {"DA","DC","DG","DT","DI","DU"}
BBATOMS = {"P","OP1","OP2","OP3","O1P","O2P","O3P","O5'","C5'","C4'","O4'","C3'","O3'","C2'","C1'","O2'"}
ANTP = "RKRGRQTYTRYQTLELEKEFHFNRYLTRRRRIEIAHALCLTERQIKIWFQNRRMKWKKEN"

# ---------- empirical contact sets measured in the previous cell (35 chains, 16 entries)
EMP_BASE  = [5, 47, 50, 51]          # base contact in >=40% of chains
EMP_BBONE = [6, 8, 25, 44, 48, 53, 55, 57]   # backbone contact in >=60%, no frequent base contact
EMP_ALL   = sorted(EMP_BASE + EMP_BBONE)

def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/%s.fasta" % a,
                                       timeout=60, headers=H).text.split("\n")[1:])
S2, S1 = fa("Q6IQ32"), fa("Q9H2P0")
HD2, HD1 = S2[1042:1102], S1[755:815]

# ---------- rebuild the register-corrected human background (240 homeodomains)
q = ("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF00046+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
     "&format=json&size=500&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_dna_bind,sequence")
j = requests.get(q, timeout=120, headers=H).json()
raw = []
for e in j["results"]:
    seq = e["sequence"]["value"]; g = e.get("genes", [{}])[0].get("geneName", {}).get("value", e["primaryAccession"])
    for ft in e.get("features", []):
        if ft["type"] == "DNA binding" and "homeobox" in (ft.get("description") or "").lower():
            s, t = ft["location"]["start"]["value"], ft["location"]["end"]["value"]
            if s and t and 55 <= t-s+1 <= 80 and s-1+60 <= len(seq): raw.append((e["primaryAccession"], g, seq, s))
raw = [r for r in raw if r[0] not in ("Q6IQ32", "Q9H2P0")]
BGF = {'A':.0788,'R':.0553,'N':.0419,'D':.0536,'C':.0193,'Q':.0393,'E':.0638,'G':.0707,'H':.0227,'I':.0591,
       'L':.0963,'K':.0595,'M':.0238,'F':.0397,'P':.0469,'S':.0683,'T':.0542,'W':.0121,'Y':.0303,'V':.0675}
a0 = 5.0
def build(sq):
    n = len(sq); cols = [Counter(h[i] for h in sq) for i in range(60)]
    return cols, [{a: np.log2(((c.get(a,0)+a0*BGF[a])/(n+a0))/BGF[a]) for a in BGF} for c in cols], n
cur = [seq[s-1:s+59] for _,_,seq,s in raw]
for _ in range(3):
    cols, pssm, n = build(cur)
    new = []
    for (acc, g, seq, s) in raw:
        best, bo = -1e9, 0
        for off in range(-20, 21):
            st = s-1+off
            if st < 0 or st+60 > len(seq): continue
            w = seq[st:st+60]; v = sum(pssm[i].get(w[i], -4.0) for i in range(60))
            if v > best: best, bo = v, off
        new.append(seq[s-1+bo:s-1+bo+60])
    if new == cur: break
    cur = new
cols, pssm, N = build(cur)
cons = "".join(c.most_common(1)[0][0] for c in cols)
bg = [(a, g, h) for (a, g, _, _), h in zip(raw, cur)]

def nmatch(h, S): return sum(h[p-1] == cons[p-1] for p in S)
def lodds(h, S):  return sum(pssm[p-1].get(h[p-1], -4.0) for p in S)

print("=== rescoring with structure-derived contact positions ===")
for label, S in [("empirical base set %s" % EMP_BASE, EMP_BASE),
                 ("empirical base+backbone set %s" % EMP_ALL, EMP_ALL)]:
    bm = np.array([nmatch(h, S) for _,_,h in bg]); bs = np.array([lodds(h, S) for _,_,h in bg])
    mu, sd = bs.mean(), bs.std(ddof=1)
    print("\n%s  (n positions = %d)" % (label, len(S)))
    print("  consensus matches:  ADNP2 %d/%d | ADNP %d/%d | background %.2f +/- %.2f"
          % (nmatch(HD2, S), len(S), nmatch(HD1, S), len(S), bm.mean(), bm.std(ddof=1)))
    v2, v1 = lodds(HD2, S), lodds(HD1, S)
    print("  log-odds: background %.1f +/- %.1f | ADNP2 %.1f (z %.2f, pct %.1f) | ADNP %.1f (z %.2f, pct %.1f)"
          % (mu, sd, v2, (v2-mu)/sd, 100*(bs < v2).mean(), v1, (v1-mu)/sd, 100*(bs < v1).mean()))
    if S is EMP_ALL:
        EMPbs, EMPmu, EMPsd, EMPv2, EMPv1 = bs, mu, sd, v2, v1
        EMPbm = bm

print("\nresidues at the structure-derived base positions:")
for p in EMP_BASE:
    print("   pos %2d  consensus %s (%.3f)  Antp %s  ADNP %s  ADNP2 %s"
          % (p, cons[p-1], cols[p-1].most_common(1)[0][1]/N, ANTP[p-1], HD1[p-1], HD2[p-1]))

# ---------- Part 2: superposition onto 9ANT
def parse(txt):
    prot = defaultdict(dict); dbase = []; dback = []
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if not (ln.startswith("ATOM") or ln.startswith("HETATM")): continue
        if ln[16] not in (" ", "A"): continue
        rn = ln[17:20].strip(); ch = ln[21]; an = ln[12:16].strip(); el = ln[76:78].strip()
        if el == "H" or an.startswith("H"): continue
        try: num = int(ln[22:26]); xyz = (float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54]))
        except ValueError: continue
        if rn in AA3: prot[ch].setdefault(num, [AA3[rn], []])[1].append((an, xyz))
        elif rn in DNA: (dback if an in BBATOMS else dbase).append(xyz)
    return prot, np.array(dbase), np.array(dback)

ant = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9ANT.pdb", timeout=120, headers=H).text
prot, dbase, dback = parse(ant)
chA = prot["A"]; nums = sorted(chA)
seqA = "".join(chA[k][0] for k in nums)
print("\n9ANT chain A sequence (%d res): %s" % (len(seqA), seqA))
# 9ANT chain A is Antennapedia itself; map canonical 1-60 by exact substring search
off = seqA.find(ANTP[:12])
print("canonical position 1 maps to 9ANT residue number", nums[off] if off >= 0 else "NOT FOUND")
ant_map = {p: nums[off + p - 1] for p in range(1, 61) if 0 <= off + p - 1 < len(nums)}

af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q6IQ32", timeout=120, headers=H).json()
afpdb = requests.get(af[0]["pdbUrl"], timeout=180, headers=H).text
afprot, _, _ = parse(afpdb)
afch = list(afprot.values())[0]
adnp2_map = {p: 1042 + p for p in range(1, 61)}      # residues 1043-1102 are canonical 1-60
chk = "".join(afch[adnp2_map[p]][0] for p in range(1, 61))
print("AlphaFold model residues 1043-1102:", chk)
print("matches the UniProt sequence slice:", chk == HD2)

def ca(resdict, num):
    for an, x in resdict[num][1]:
        if an == "CA": return np.array(x)
    return None

CORE_RANGE = [p for p in range(7, 58)]    # three helices, excludes the flexible N-terminal arm
P = np.array([ca(afch, adnp2_map[p]) for p in CORE_RANGE])
Qm = np.array([ca(chA, ant_map[p]) for p in CORE_RANGE])
Pc, Qc = P - P.mean(0), Qm - Qm.mean(0)
U, Sv, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Pc.T @ Qc)
d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(U @ Vt))
R = U @ np.diag([1, 1, d]) @ Vt
Pr = Pc @ R + Qm.mean(0)
rmsd = np.sqrt(((Pr - Qm)**2).sum(1).mean())
print("\nKabsch superposition of ADNP2 1043-1102 onto 9ANT Antennapedia, CA of canonical 7-57")
print("  n atoms = %d, RMSD = %.2f A" % (len(P), rmsd))

def xform(x): return (np.array(x) - P.mean(0)) @ R + Qm.mean(0)
print("\nin the superposed frame, minimum heavy-atom distance to DNA (Angstrom)")
print("pos  Antp_res  d_base  d_bb   ADNP2_res  d_base  d_bb   note")
rows = []
for p in sorted(set(EMP_ALL + [3, 31, 54])):
    an_num = ant_map.get(p); a2_num = adnp2_map.get(p)
    if an_num is None or a2_num is None: continue
    aatoms = np.array([x for _, x in chA[an_num][1]])
    batoms = np.array([xform(x) for _, x in afch[a2_num][1]])
    da_b = np.min(np.linalg.norm(aatoms[:,None,:] - dbase[None,:,:], axis=2))
    da_k = np.min(np.linalg.norm(aatoms[:,None,:] - dback[None,:,:], axis=2))
    db_b = np.min(np.linalg.norm(batoms[:,None,:] - dbase[None,:,:], axis=2))
    db_k = np.min(np.linalg.norm(batoms[:,None,:] - dback[None,:,:], axis=2))
    cls = "base" if p in EMP_BASE else ("backbone" if p in EMP_BBONE else "lit-only")
    print("%3d    %s     %5.1f  %5.1f      %s     %5.1f  %5.1f   %s"
          % (p, chA[an_num][0], da_b, da_k, afch[a2_num][0], db_b, db_k, cls))
    rows.append((p, chA[an_num][0], da_b, da_k, afch[a2_num][0], db_b, db_k, cls))

# ---------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.4))
ax[0].hist(EMPbs, bins=30, color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white")
ax[0].axvline(EMPv2, color="#d1495b", lw=2.5); ax[0].axvline(EMPv1, color="#2a9d8f", lw=2.5)
ax[0].annotate("ADNP2 %.1f" % EMPv2, (EMPv2, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.90), color="#d1495b", fontsize=10)
ax[0].annotate("ADNP %.1f" % EMPv1, (EMPv1, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.74), color="#2a9d8f", fontsize=10)
ax[0].set_xlabel("log-odds over 12 structure-derived contact positions")
ax[0].set_ylabel("human homeodomains (n=%d)" % N)
ax[0].set_title("Contact positions taken from 35 DNA-bound chains")
pos = [r[0] for r in rows]
x = np.arange(len(pos))
ax[1].bar(x-0.2, [r[2] for r in rows], 0.4, color="#2a9d8f", label="Antennapedia in 9ANT")
ax[1].bar(x+0.2, [r[5] for r in rows], 0.4, color="#d1495b", label="ADNP2 model, superposed")
ax[1].axhline(4.0, color="black", ls="--", lw=1)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(["%d%s/%s" % (r[0], r[1], r[4]) for r in rows], rotation=90, fontsize=7)
ax[1].set_ylabel("min distance to DNA base atoms (A)")
ax[1].set_xlabel("canonical position, Antp residue / ADNP2 residue")
ax[1].set_title("RMSD %.2f A over %d CA; dashed line is the 4 A contact cutoff" % (rmsd, len(P)))
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
